text:
Our poems cannot

be published yet


They circulate from hand to hand

in manuscript


Or copied on mimeograph

but one day


the name will be forgotten

of the dictator against whom

they were written,


And they will go on being read.

translation.title: Our Poems Cannot
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the contrast between clandestine circulation and the poems' longer life beyond the dictator.
